input_output.RGB: native uint8 RGB; no contrast stretch
input_output.RGB_resize: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR on uint8, H=640 W=232, then /255 and channel normalization
input_output.GT: native binary mask must be checked before use; preserve native GT unchanged
input_output.GT_to_input: OpenCV INTER_NEAREST to 640x232, binary float32 in {0,1}; no dilation or distance mask
input_output.GT_to_feature: torch bilinear to (160,58), align_corners=True; values <0.5 become 0, >=0.5 become 1
input_output.feature_copy: author generator duplicates B to 2B; not two independent real images
input_output.empty_feature_GT: stop if any R5 becomes empty; do not replace sample, dilate or borrow U
native_score_order: author GaussianBlur kernel25 sigma4 reflect on logits
bilinear smoothed input logits to native H,W, align_corners=False
one-channel sigmoid to native float32 probability, each native pixel once
input_output.classification: sigmoid of independent raw classification-head logit; no spatial pooling substitution
input_output.localization_max: max of native sigmoid map; supplemental, not the classification score
input_output.calibration: not performed or numerically frozen at this stage; future Q only, no old threshold reuse
input_output.evaluation: no test-pool minmax, smoothing after sigmoid, resized evaluation GT, softmax or best-checkpoint selection
input_output.BN: author BatchNorm retained; not old GN or stateless BN
input_output.budget: pilot steps/epochs, sample sequence, gate and formal budget remain unfrozen
input_output.data_codec_status: core environment has no OpenCV wheel; decode/resize implementation and runtime dependency are a stage-3 prerequisite, not claimed ready

optimizer.algorithm: author get_optimizers: AdamW, three groups, no backbone params
optimizer.scheduler: author epoch-unit MultiStepLR at 0.8*epochs,0.9*epochs, gamma0.4; not old 8000/9000 step schedule
optimizer.loss: seg normal truncated-L1 mean + seg anomaly truncated-L1 mean + all-pixel focal mean + cls focal mean
optimizer.empty_normal_or_anomaly_subset: zero contribution, as author train.py; no zero-division
optimizer.segmentation_available: all strict-R5/normal samples fully segmented; no weak labels or loss-mask weighting
optimizer.gradient_clipping_future: author supervised entry: clip global gradient norm to1 if enabled; not executed

schedule.scheduler_unit: epoch; call scheduler.step once AFTER all32 updates of epoch
schedule.sampling_purpose: balanced finite-pool fitting pilot, not author datamodule or a formal training budget
schedule.resume: manual only: own complete checkpoint -> NEW run name/output, restore model+BN+optimizer+scheduler+Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG and same sequence cursor; original partial run preserved
schedule.GPU_bitwise_replay_and_full_recovery: not yet empirically verified; seeded run is not a bitwise guarantee

gate.rationale: high pooled feature-scale fitting plus a per-real-image floor prevents the largest mask dominating; classify all5 and at least15/16 normals correctly at a fixed reference, not a Q-calibrated threshold
gate.status: pre-run engineering acceptance policy, not a paper performance claim or guaranteed achievable value

resources.time: unknown before manual pilot; no old-model timing substituted

inference: not automatic after train; separately invoked score caches each of21 once using final1600 step, segmentation hook + same eval call; no BN/parameter updates

runtime_status: Torch import, parameter match, model fit, resource peaks and full recovery untested
